simple.meaning: אֵל (ʼêl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “these or those.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 19:8. The surrounding context includes family, family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵל (H411) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֵל (ʼêl) / H411 is traced through Genesis 19:8, Genesis 19:25, Genesis 26:3, Genesis 26:4 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H411. el I. אֵל pronoun plural masculine & feminine = the more usual אֵלֶּה , these 1Chr 20:8 ; with article הָאֵל Gen 19:8 ; 19:25 ; 26:3 ; 26:4 ; Lev 18:27 ; Deut 4:42 ; Deuteronomy 7:72; 19:11 . (Merely an orthographic variation of אֵלֶּה , and doubtless pronounced similarly; the kindred dialects have in Genl. a dissyllabic form: see below אֵלֶּה . Written similarly in Phoenician, e.g. CIS 3:22 ; 14:5 ; Deut 93:3( האל ), but ZMG 1875, 240 (Neo-Punic) אלא ; in Plaut. Poen. see I. 9 transliterated ily ; Schroed Phoenician Gr. p. 81, 160, 286 ff. )
definitions.rootNote: a demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense)

occurrences.englishText: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,
(for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;
These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
